stack.sourceAdoption: Only a reviewed application-owned subset, pinned by source revision and content digest before M01 copying. Select the Radix variant for both shadcn/ui and Animate UI. No Base UI mixture, paid templates, runtime registry fetches or design-service account.

animateUIAdoption.reason: The exact historical candidate's MIT root license resolves the M00 root-license blocker, not component adoption. M01 must review selected Radix files, notices and all transitive dependencies. Do not fetch current main's registry or follow unreviewed nested registry references; use reviewed pinned local sources and locked dependencies.

designTokens.semanticStatus: Use distinct text for severity, verification, source health and workflow. Color is supplementary; no implied risk reduction from an accepted or unseen finding.

referenceDevice.cpu: Intel Core i5-1235U laptop, proposed reference, not measured

largeList.strategy: Accessible server-side pagination first, not an unbounded animated DOM.

measurement.protocol: Record the exact browser build and host before each measurement. Use a seeded 10000-row authorized list, representative long evidence text and simultaneous development-profile ingestion. Measure at least 30 repetitions after warm-up per action, both themes and motion modes; record p95, longest task, dropped frames and API latency separately. Reference browser changes require a recorded baseline decision.

contextPreservation.responseRule: Bind requests to workspace, authorized filter/snapshot and selected finding; cancel or ignore obsolete generations. A permission/workspace change clears ineligible data, not an invitation to restore stale secrets.
contextPreservation.returnFocus: Restore the opening control when still present; otherwise focus the corresponding row or the list heading and announce why.

selection.scopeLabel: Show current-page count or all-matching count plus the exact authorized filter/snapshot.
selection.refresh: Keep membership stable while acting. New rows do not silently join an existing all-matches selection; changed permissions are rechecked at execution.
selection.partialFailure: Report per-item success/failure and retained selection for eligible retries. Never present a partially applied bulk command as complete.

motion.rules: No continuous ornamental animation or per-row stagger across the dataset. Do not tween risk/count values or advance a stalled stage. Default system preference must cover Motion, owned CSS and copied components, not only a preference hook.

accessibility.focusRules: Use native semantics and reviewed Radix focus behavior. Dialog focus trapping/return, escape behavior, error association and live announcements are required acceptance checks. Sticky headers/toolbars may not obscure focus.

stateGuidance.empty: No results in the authorized scope; offer a relevant import/source/filter action.
stateGuidance.loading: Reserve layout and identify the pending operation, without invented counts.
stateGuidance.stale: Retain useful prior results with source scan and projection age, not a refreshed timestamp.
stateGuidance.failed: Persistent concise cause, impact and retry/diagnostic action; do not replace with demo content.
stateGuidance.partial-data: Show collected scope and missing permissions/stages separately.
stateGuidance.permission-denied: No restricted evidence preview; explain the permitted access-request path.
stateGuidance.success: Show only the confirmed operation outcome and the supported undo path.

acceptanceBoundary: The storyboard and JSON are design inputs, not rendered React/shadcn/Animate UI conformance or measured performance. Review light/dark, zoom, small-screen, keyboard and reduced-motion behavior before approving implementation.
